_about: Template for the editor package manifest read by studio/editor_package.py. Copy it into the film folder as editor.json and replace every value. Times are seconds on the film's timeline; paths are relative to editor.json. Shots must cover the picture back to back. Stems are post-fader and pre-master. picture_filter is the master's finishing pass (mux.sh grain 2 is noise=c0s=2:allf=t); use an empty string when the master had none.
title: <Film title>
notes: <what the owner should know before editing, e.g. the grain is baked into the picture>
